sentences.text:
This is first application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, for grant of bail filed on behalf of the applicant relating to FIR/Crime No.1154/2023 dated 25.08.2023 registered at Police Station Kolgawan, District Satna for the offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(n), 376(3),
506, 450 of IPC, Section 4/5 of POCSO Act, 2012.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is in judicial custody since 25.08.2023 and the trial will take considerable time to conclude.

He further submits that the applicant is Sheikh Rasool vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/108832473/
1 innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.

sentences.text: The applicant is a permanent resident of the district and there is no likelihood of his absconding or tampering with prosecution evidence.
He is ready to furnish adequate surety and shall abide by all the conditions to be imposed by the Court.
Upon these grounds, it is prayed that the applicant be released on bail.
Learned counsel for the State has opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.
The parents of the victim are present in the Court.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
In this case, the prosecutrix aged almost 10 years was sexually abused by the applicant and a video was prepared by him.
He blackmailed the prosecutrix on many occasions on the ground that he would show her video to her parents and repeatedly abused her sexually.
Mobile phone of applicant is allegedly seized from the possession of father of victim, from which obscene photos and videos have been recovered and stored in a pen drive.

The bail application has been argued on the ground that there is an unexplained delay in lodging the FIR, but having considered the age of prosecutrix and the mental status of her parents after being informed by her about the sexual abuse, this delay cannot be a ground to allow the bail application.
According, the bail application is dismissed.

(ANURADHA SHUKLA) JUDGE rv Sheikh Rasool vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/108832473/
